description: This file defines the AutomationEngine class which manages various automation processes for recipes, including keyword, unit, food, and regex-based replacements, with caching mechanisms.

classes.name: AutomationEngine
classes.description: A class that handles automation rules for recipes, including applying keyword, unit, food, and regex-based transformations with caching.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AutomationEngine with request, cache usage flag, and optional source string.

methods.name: apply_keyword_automation
methods.description: Applies keyword alias automation to a given keyword, utilizing cache and database lookups.

methods.name: apply_unit_automation
methods.description: Applies unit alias automation to a given unit, utilizing cache and database lookups.

methods.name: apply_food_automation
methods.description: Applies food alias automation to a given food item, utilizing cache and database lookups.

methods.name: apply_never_unit_automation
methods.description: Moves tokens that should never be treated as units to the next token, optionally replacing with a default unit.

methods.name: apply_transpose_automation
methods.description: Swaps the position of two words in a string if they are detected in sequence, based on automation rules.

methods.name: apply_regex_replace_automation
methods.description: Performs regex-based replacements on strings based on automation rules, utilizing cache and database.
